d: Pakistan’s cricket team is facing fresh controversy amid allegations of match-fixing and misconduct. The PCB reportedly confiscated the mobile phones of several players, including Mohammed Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq, with data from the devices reportedly transferred for an internal inquiry. The controversy follows Pakistan’s poor Test series against England, the sending home of seven players, and an earlier dispute involving Imran Khan’s sons. With echoes of Pakistan’s infamous 2010 Lord’s match-fixing scandal, questions are once again being raised about the team. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you…
